This file joins the binary and multiclass dataframes together into one dataframe
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load binary and multiclass predictions

load(here("results/binaryclass_results/predictions.RData"))

load(here("results/mclass_results/preds-groupN.RData"))


# Join by .id to create final prediction dataframe with both binary and multiclass
pred_df <- pred_df_binary %>%
  inner_join(pred_df, by = ".id")

# Save final combined predictions
save(pred_df, file = here("results", "preds-group8.RData"))
```
